name: Talhovi
description: Talhovi was a Mid Rim world located in the Juvex sector. It was the homeworld of the Mekuun family, with whom the Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex region had prohibited trade. Talhovi nevertheless remained economically powerful and exported goods such as Talhovian ale.
